claims.claim_text: On these older units, don't trust the green link status, sometimes after changing the SFP the interface comes up but forwarding doesn't recover. Usually the SFP is fine, so check whether traffic counters are increasing, and if they stay at zero while the interface is UP, disable the interface, wait a little, then enable it again, and don't reboot the whole unit unless that fails.
claims.symptom: Link up and alarms cleared after SFP replacement but traffic not coming back
claims.check_step: Check whether the traffic counters are actually increasing
claims.action: Disable the interface, wait a little, then enable it again
claims.do_not_before: Don't reboot the whole unit unless that fails
